Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE NO
ORDINANCE NO.LX OF
2001
CIVIL SERVANTS
(SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
(An Ordinance
further to amend the Civil Servants Act, 1973)
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
24th October,
2001]
F. No. 2(1)/2001-Pub.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be called the Civil Servants (Second
Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Section 1, Ordinance XXXIII of 2001

F. No. 2(1)/2001-Pub.---The
following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby published for
general information:---
2. Amendment of section 1,
Ordinance XXXIII of 2001.--In the (Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001 (XXXIII of 2001), in section 1, in subsection (2), after the word
"once,". at the end, the words, figures and comma "and shall be
deemed to have taken effect on the first day of May, 2000" shall be added
and shall be deemed always to have been so added.
